EXPLORING INTELLIGENT SYSTEMS

Research

Perception, reasoning, and action in the real world.

I am a Ph.D. student at KAIST, advised by Prof. Han-Lim Choi in the Laboratory for Information and Control Systems (LiCS). My research interests include vision-language models, multi-agent systems, and intelligent robotics. I am particularly interested in how robot swarms coordinate and make decentralized decisions under limited sensing, communication, and computation. My long-term interests also include superintelligence and how learning and reasoning can enable more capable autonomous systems.

  • Vision-Language Models
  • Multi-Agent Systems
  • Intelligent Robotics
  • Superintelligence
